entity_types.name: party
entity_types.definition: A person or organisation recorded as acting in a role on an IP right application; identified by party_id, with party_type as a party classification only and no legal-form inference.

entity_types.name: ip_application
entity_types.definition: An IP right application identified by ip_right_type plus application_number, carrying its own status, dates and description.

entity_types.name: party_activity
entity_types.definition: The association of one party in one role on one IP right application, with its own validity window (effective_from_date, effective_to_date, is_current).

concepts.definition: Publisher's identifier for the party named on an IP right application record (party_activity.party_id). Identifies the party across applications and roles; it is not a business registration number, ABN or ACN, and does not by itself establish a legal entity.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers an IP-office party key; entity.abn and entity.acn are checksummed business/company registrations with different owners and meaning, and entity.legal_name is a registered name, not an identifier.

concepts.definition: Party name as published on the IP right application record (party_activity.party_name), free text and lower-cased. It may be an organisation name variant or a personal name; it is not asserted to be a registered legal name or a trading name.
concepts.why_not_existing: entity.legal_name and entity.trading_name are owned by business and assert registered/trading status; this value is an unverified IP-office party label owned by the party role, so reuse would change meaning and owner.

concepts.definition: Publisher's classification of the party on the IP right application record as an organisation or an individual (party_activity.party_type). This is a party classification only; it does not state a company legal form, sole-trader status or beneficial ownership.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.holder_kind is owned by business and is matching evidence about a licence/registration holder; entity.entity_type and ext.entity.legal_form assert business legal structure. A party-level organisation/individual flag with no legal-form implication is a distinct meaning on a different owner.

concepts.definition: Australian Business Number as supplied on the IP right application party record (party_activity.abn), recorded as an 11-digit string. It is frequently blank, and a blank must not be read as absence of a business or of an Australian presence; it is not validated here and does not establish the party's legal identity.
concepts.why_not_existing: entity.abn is owned by business and is defined as a validated business identifier; this value is an unvalidated, often-missing party-record attribute whose absence is not evidence, so reuse would change meaning, owner and validation scope.

concepts.definition: Publisher's broad category of the role the party holds on the IP right application record (party_activity.party_role_category), e.g. applicant, applicant_agent, opposition, mortgagee. Describes the party-role record only; it does not imply ownership, beneficial interest or enforceability of the application.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers an IP-office party-role category; ext.licence.category and ext.licence.status are owned by licence and describe an authorisation, not a party's role on an application, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

concepts.definition: Publisher's specific role the party holds on the IP right application record (party_activity.party_role), e.g. applicant, patentee, agent, opponent. A finer-grained companion to the role category; it describes the party-role record, not the application or the business lifecycle.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept expresses a party's specific role on an IP application; ext.licence.category is a licence category owned by licence, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

concepts.definition: Publisher's flag on the party-role record stating whether the party is recorded as founding (party_activity.is_founding, true/false). It is a party-role attribute and must not be read as a business establishment date or as evidence of incorporation.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.date_established is a business establishment date owned by business; a boolean founding flag on a party-role record has a different owner, type and meaning, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Publisher's flag stating whether the party-role record is currently valid (party_activity.is_current, true/false). It describes the validity of the party-role association, not the application's status or the business's lifecycle.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.licence.status is a licence status owned by licence; a boolean currency flag on a party-role record has a different owner, type and meaning, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Publisher-stated start of the validity window of the party-role record (party_activity.effective_from_date). It is the commencement of the party's role association on the application, not the application filing/priority date and not the business establishment date.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.licence.start_date is owned by licence and ext.entity.date_established is owned by business; neither covers the validity start of a party-role association, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

concepts.definition: Publisher-stated end of the validity window of the party-role record (party_activity.effective_to_date), frequently blank when the role is open-ended. It is the end of the party's role association on the application, not the application termination date and not the end of the business.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.licence.end_date is owned by licence and describes a licence's end; the end of a party-role association has a different owner and meaning, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Country component of the address recorded for the party on the IP right application record (party_activity.country_code), as published and lower-cased (e.g. 'au', 'us', 'cn'). It is frequently blank, and a blank must not be read as an Australian address or as absence of a country. It is a party-record address attribute, not a statement of the party's place of incorporation or of the business's registered office.
concepts.why_not_existing: address.country is owned by business and describes the business's own stated address; this value is an unverified, often-missing address attribute of an IP-office party record, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

concepts.definition: State or province component of the address recorded for the party on the IP right application record (party_activity.state_code), as published and lower-cased (e.g. 'nsw', 'vic'). Values are not restricted to Australian states and are frequently blank; it is a party-record address attribute, not a business operating region or a statement of incorporation.
concepts.why_not_existing: address.state is owned by business, is an enum of Australian/NZ/OTHER codes and describes the business's own address; this raw, lower-cased, non-Australian-only party-record value has a different owner and scope, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Post code component of the address recorded for the party on the IP right application record (party_activity.post_code), kept as the raw published string because formats are not uniform (e.g. '2106' vs 'gu14 0lx'). It is a party-record address attribute and is not normalised to an Australian postcode.
concepts.why_not_existing: address.postcode is owned by business and describes the business's own address; this unnormalised, mixed-format party-record value has a different owner and no guaranteed Australian scope, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Publisher's identifier for the IP right application (application.application_number, repeated as party_activity.application_number), as published. It identifies the application only in combination with the IP right type; it is not a business registration number, ABN or ACN, and does not identify the party or the business.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers an IP-office application number; ext.licence.number and ext.licence.related_licence_number are owned by licence and identify authorisations, and ext.entity.prior_registration_number is a legacy business registration number, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

concepts.definition: Publisher's classification of the kind of IP right the application seeks (application.ip_right_type, repeated as party_activity.ip_right_type), e.g. patent. It classifies the application, not the party or the business, and does not state that any right has been granted or is enforceable. The value list reflects the patent-prefix cohort in this snapshot and is not a general IP-right-type vocabulary.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept classifies an IP right application; ext.licence.category and ext.licence.authorisation are owned by licence and describe an authorisation held by a business, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

concepts.definition: Publisher's sub-classification of the IP right application within its IP right type (application.ip_right_sub_type). For patents the observed vocabulary includes standard_complete, innovation, provisional and petty; the list is not asserted to be exhaustive of the publisher's vocabulary. It describes the application's own category and does not imply grant, enforceability or a business attribute.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept expresses an application sub-type; ext.licence.category is a licence category owned by licence, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

relationships.name: PARTY_ACTS_ON_APPLICATION
relationships.definition: A party is recorded in a role on an IP right application, via a party-activity record; the role does not imply ownership, beneficial interest or enforceability.

relationships.name: PARTY_ACTIVITY_RECORDS_PARTY
relationships.definition: A party-activity record names the party that holds the recorded role.

relationships.name: PARTY_ACTIVITY_CONCERNS_APPLICATION
relationships.definition: A party-activity record concerns the IP right application identified by its application number and IP right type.

relationships.name: APPLICATION_HAS_DESCRIPTION
relationships.definition: An IP right application has at most one description record, linked by application number and IP right type.
